title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Do you got the 60-man?
Hi Anthony, I’m doing great, thanks for asking. How are you?
[Attachment: Image]
Thanks
[Attachment: Image]
How many players is it?
I’ll count, sorry
John, man. Talking about Edward Murrow
Do you get the sense he’s bored?
Are you going to be tweeting out that graphic?
List
Of the players, or is Tigers PR
I’m having a graphic made up that has headshots hopefully. PR might still tweet that.
When are they posting
idk. Still waiting to find out more
“If the Tigers don’t have Spencer Torkelson on their 60-man roster ...”
Well I think they had 59 players (though I believe Stokes is now being kept off) so they probably left room for him
Wait
Thanks
So with no Stokes it’s 58
I think they’re seeing all these teams adding fewer guys
And they’re like, “You know what? Maybe we can add fewer, too”
Nah, I think it’s just because Stokes got injured haha
Lol
Always looking for that angle to rip them
Do you know if Stokes got injured for sure?
[Attachment: Image]
K
Do you think Courtney has the schedule
Or do you
It’s so hard to write this shit, man. I have Stokes from another source
I’m trying to slip in a “believed that he may have sustained an injury” ... he broke his hamate bone
But since I know that you know
I just don’t put that shit out there because of caution
I don’t have the schedule unfortunately. I doubt Courtney does
[Attachment: Image]
Need to update the part about Torkelson eventually
Really
Nothing in the signing, it just reads funny
Yeah at the fronts
Front*
I put “One of those two open spots likely will go”
Thank yo
Of course. When I get a heads up about the schedule I’ll let you know. I’m hopeful that comes tomorrow.
Al is stonewalling me
It’s crazy, though. It doesn’t even matter anymore
I used to be so worked up about that shit but I’ve literally sat on two things this week
Because IDGAF
I knew about Alex Wilson but I can’t risk them sniffing my sources out
Anyways, that was rant-y sorry.
Eh, you gotta wait for your moment. Alex Wilson and Troy Stokes aren’t worth it
